summary: RETEST of iteration 20's login regression PASSED. Re-adding `import { BACKEND_URL, ... } from '@/src/theme'` in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx fixed the ReferenceError inside requestOtp/verifyOtp. Verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844) against the public EXPO_BACKEND_URL: (1) Employer flow — landing → I'M HIRING → sign-in → email → POST /api/auth/email/request-otp (200, otp-block shown) → wrong OTP renders 'Incorrect code. Try again.' via login-otp-error → change-email link resets to email entry → new email + OTP read from db.email_otps → verify → session_token stored (len=51) → routed to /employer. (2) Freelancer flow — I'M LOOKING FOR A JOB routes directly to /freelancer/jobs signed-out (browse-first intact); unverified banner shows 'Browse freely — sign in to apply' with SIGN IN CTA (banner-verify-cta) → sign-in screen → email OTP login completes → routed back to /freelancer/jobs → banner now reads 'Browse freely — verify to apply · Tap APPLY on any gig to start the one-time ₹99 Verified Pro onboarding (profile + email OTP) and chat with employers.' with VERIFY CTA — the 'profile + email OTP' copy is confirmed reachable for signed-in unverified freelancers. (3) Google button (login-google-btn) still renders on sign-in screen — regression clean. All test users/sessions/email_otps have been purged from db.test_database.

rca_of_issue: Iteration 20's 'Network error, zero network requests' bug was caused by a missing top-level import of BACKEND_URL in app/index.tsx. The async requestOtp/verifyOtp bodies referenced BACKEND_URL, which threw a ReferenceError before fetch was invoked; the empty catch({}) mapped every failure to a generic 'Network error. Try again.' Fix (already applied by main agent) re-adds `import { BACKEND_URL, COLORS, RADIUS, SPACING } from '@/src/theme'` at line 17. Verified in this iteration: POST /api/auth/email/request-otp fires (captured on wire), otp-block appears, wrong OTP → login-otp-error message, correct OTP → session adopted and route to /employer or /freelancer/jobs.
